# FlowBoard

> FlowBoard is a simple kanban board web app. Users sign in, create boards, organize work into columns and cards, and move cards between columns (by drag and drop or from a menu) to track progress.

## What it does
- Create, rename and delete boards
- Add columns and cards with titles and descriptions
- Move cards between columns with drag and drop or keyboard-accessible controls
- Sign in with email and password or a magic link

## Pages
- [Sign in](/login): the only public page. Boards are private to each signed-in user.
